item.title: 2006 Porsche Cayman S 6-Speed
item.description: This 2006 Porsche Cayman S has 55k miles and is powered by a 3.4-liter flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. The car is finished in Basalt Black Metallic over black leather and has been modified with a Fabspeed titanium exhaust system, an aftermarket fixed rear spoiler, aftermarket LED taillights and side markers, H&R lowering springs, a Kenwood touchscreen head unit, an Alpine amplifier, and a JL Audio 12″ subwoofer. item.title: Fuel-Injected 1962 Chevrolet Corvette 4-Speed
item.description: This black-over-black 1962 Chevrolet Corvette is powered by a fuel-injected replacement 327ci V8 backed by a four-speed manual transmission and a Positraction differential. The car was refurbished in the 1970s and purchased by the previous owner on BaT in October 2024. Additional equipment includes 15″ steel wheels, a heater, and a removable hardtop. Acquired by the selling dealer in 2026, this C1 Corvette is now offered with a California title.

item.title: 4k-Mile 2019 Ferrari 488 Pista
item.description: This 2019 Ferrari 488 Pista was exported to Canada in 2019 and spent time in Quebec and Ontario prior to being relocated back to the US in 2025, and it now has 4k miles. Nero and Grigio Silverstone stripes accent the Rosso Corsa-finished body, and the car is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V8 paired with a seven-speed F1 dual-clutch automatic transaxle. item.description: This 2003 Boston Whaler Sport 130 was purchased in 2023 by the seller who carried out a refurbishment that involved replacing the wiring, fasteners, and hardware as needed in addition to mounting a 2005 Mercury 40-horsepower four-stroke outboard and wrapping the topsides with pink vinyl wrap. item.title: 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S Coupe 6-Speed
item.description: This 1997 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S was registered in California for 18 years prior to the seller's purchase in 2025. Specified in Ocean Blue Metallic with a black Supple leather interior, the car has been fitted with Bilstein coilover suspension and a Fabspeed exhaust system. item.title: 2013 Maserati GranTurismo Convertible
item.description: This 2013 Maserati GranTurismo convertible was initially delivered in California and spent time in South Dakota and Florida through the seller's acquisition in 2024. Finished in Grigio Alfieri over Nero leather, the car is powered by a 4.7-liter V8 linked with a six-speed automatic gearbox and a limited-slip differential. item.title: 3,900-Kilometer 2004 Porsche 911 GT3 RS
item.description: This 2004 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is one of just 682 examples produced exclusively for RoW markets and was sold new in Germany before being brought to the US under a “show or display” exemption in 2021. The seller purchased it in 2024 from Porsche Salt Lake City in Utah and has since added approximately 300 of the 3,900 kilometers (~2,400 miles) indicated. The car is finished in Carrara White with red GT3 RS graphics and powered by a 3.6-liter Mezger flat-six linked with a six-speed manual transaxle

item.title: Euro 1986 Ferrari 328 GTB
item.description: This European-market 1986 Ferrari 328 GTB is one of 1,344 fixed-roof Berlinetta models produced, and it spent time in France and Belgium before being imported to the US in 2024. Finished in Blu Medio Metallizzato over a special-ordered Cartier Red leather interior, the car is powered by a fuel-injected 3.2-liter V8 linked with a five-speed manual transaxle and a limited-slip differential. Equipment includes an aftermarket exhaust and stereo as well as a gated shifter, concave 16" Speedline wheel

item.title: 8k-Mile 2017 Acura NSX
item.description: This 2017 Acura NSX was purchased new by the seller and was optioned with carbon-fiber exterior and interior accents in addition to the $10k carbon-ceramic brakes. It is finished in white over red and black upholstery and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 linked to three electric motors, a nine-speed dual-clutch automatic transaxle, and Acura's Super Handling All-Wheel-Drive system.
